warnings.noWarningsDesc: No critical unmet hours, load shedding, or battery reserve breaches detected.

warnings.sectorCappedDesc: {sector} power intake was capped by operator limit between {from} and {to}.
warnings.lifelineShortfallDesc: {sector} received less than its survival minimum between {from} and {to}. Water and health are kept on first.
warnings.fireIsolationDesc: {sector} is cut off (0 kW) between {from} and {to} because of a fire. Safety rule: no strategy, cap or survival floor overrides it.

strategies.subtitle: Side-by-side comparison of allocation algorithms under identical conditions
strategies.proportionalRule: Shares available power equally based on sector demand
strategies.essentialFirstRule: Prioritizes critical health clinic & water pumping first
strategies.balancedRule: Guarantees critical baseline and applies weighted sharing for remaining energy
strategies.comparisonChartSubtitle: Delivered energy, essential coverage, unmet demand, and battery reserve
strategies.comparisonChartSummary: Side-by-side chart comparing delivered energy in kWh, essential coverage percentage, unmet demand in kWh, and ending battery SoC percentage across strategies.
strategies.identicalInputs: Fixed inputs: {scenario} ({pv} kWp PV · {battery} kWh battery)
strategies.emptyDesc: Run strategy comparison to evaluate trade-offs between Proportional and Essential-First policies under current scenario conditions.
strategies.compareEmptyDesc: Run all strategies on the same scenario to compare them.
strategies.summaryHeroDesc: Essential-First eliminates critical power outages ({essUnserved} unserved for clinic & water vs {propUnserved} on Proportional), protecting vital services during solar drop.
strategies.summaryNominalDesc: Under current conditions, available generation and storage satisfy 100% of community demand across all strategies with zero unserved energy.
strategies.summaryStressDesc: Extended shortfall requires prioritizing critical healthcare and water infrastructure over residential and commercial loads.
strategies.copilotPromoDesc: Explore why essential services were impacted and test custom solar or battery patches with the grounded Copilot.

params.title: Comparison parameters
params.subtitle: Same inputs for all three strategies. Results update automatically.
params.sectorRulesDesc: Priorities change Essential-First and Balanced; Proportional ignores them. Caps apply to every strategy.
params.strategyRulesDesc: Adjust priority weights for Balanced allocation and critical demand share guaranteed to each sector.
params.balancedWeightsDesc: Weights used during pass 2 to share energy beyond the critical baseline.
params.criticalSharesDesc: Guaranteed lifeline fraction per sector during deficit conditions.

errors.outOfRange: Value is outside the allowed range (0–500 kW, hours 0–24).
errors.capHoursOrder: End hour must be after start hour.
errors.allWeightsZero: At least one priority weight must be greater than 0.

params.lifelineFloorsDesc: Minimum power each connected sector keeps during a deficit (light, phone charging, radio) instead of being cut. Below the total, only water and health stay on.
params.lifelineOffNote: Survival floors are off: in a deficit, a sector can drop to 0 kW.

sensitivity.title: Sensitivity Sweep Analysis
sensitivity.subtitle: Critical load unserved across parameter variations
sensitivity.summary: Line chart showing critical unserved energy in kWh across variation of {param} for compared strategies.
sensitivity.divergenceDesc: At {param} = {value}, strategies diverge by {diff} kWh in critical unserved energy. {best} protects critical loads best ({bestVal} kWh unserved vs {worstVal} kWh for {worst}).
sensitivity.noDivergenceDesc: Across the tested {param} range, all selected strategies deliver identical critical service protection.
sensitivity.emptyDesc: Select valid parameter bounds to compute the sensitivity curve.
